svg.title: Retries multiply across layers
svg.desc: RETRIES AT THREE LAYERS ONE RETRY OWNER API service data client up to 27 calls API service data client up to 3 calls Three total attempts at each layer can multiply into 3 × 3 × 3 leaf calls. Assign retry ownership; bound attempts and elapsed time. Jitter limits synchronized retries. Motion timing is illustrative, not a production measurement. The loop restart is not a system event.
